site.description.message: Dataway embeds API editing, debugging, publishing, and OpenAPI documents into Hasor, Solon, and Spring applications.

homepage.hero.description.message: Dataway embeds API editing, debugging, and publishing into your Java application. DataQL expresses data queries, transformations, and aggregation in scripts.

homepage.hero.note.message: Embedded in your app · Visual development · Open source

homepage.console.description.message: Write, debug, and publish APIs in your browser.

homepage.console.edit.message: Test DataQL or SQL scripts with request parameters.

homepage.console.result.message: Preview JSON, text, tables, or images, or download files.

homepage.console.publish.message: Call published APIs and manage drafts and release history.

homepage.language.title.message: Data in the shape you need.

homepage.language.description.message: Compose data with expressions, functions, and transformations. Develop APIs in Dataway or run the engine independently in Java.

homepage.query.transform.message: Select fields and compute new values in a single transformation.

homepage.query.group.message: Import a built-in function to group records by a field.

homepage.query.sql.message: Query a database with the SQL executor. This example uses ds1 from the example application.

homepage.feature.sources.description.message: Query named data sources using application transactions.

homepage.feature.auth.description.message: Use your login system to control API and console access.

homepage.feature.docs.description.message: Generate OpenAPI and Swagger docs with interactive requests.

homepage.feature.results.description.message: Return JSON, CSV, and more, with custom result handlers.

homepage.application.description.message: Integrate with Spring, Solon, or Hasor and reuse your data sources and services.

homepage.start.description.message: Publish a SQL API with the Spring example, or begin with a DataQL script.

homepage.description.message: Edit, debug, and publish APIs in Java with Dataway. Query, transform, and combine data with DataQL. Integrates with Spring, Solon, Hasor, multiple data sources, and OpenAPI.

homepage.dataway.description.message: Connect to your application's existing data sources and business services, then configure and publish APIs.

homepage.dataql.integrations.message: Connect to data sources and services

homepage.participation.description.message: Share your experience, report issues, and help improve {project}.

homepage.dataql.description.message: Query, transform, and aggregate data with scripts that run in Java applications or Dataway APIs.
